name: Zen Traoré-Matai
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Ashland and Division
description:
Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 33, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a netrunner out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
To find the person who burned them and make it educational
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
psychology.secret: Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: The fixer who handles Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo's reputation — and a price for silence
Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Kadiatou Eriksson-Diallo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander with significant South Asian and Eastern European admixture — a striking blend visible in facial structure combining broad cheekbones and strong jaw from African ancestry, with the darker eye shape and skin depth influenced by Pacific Islander genetics, softened by South Asian and Eastern European features creating an ethnically ambiguous but distinctly cosmopolitan appearance
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — minimal body fat, long limbs, compressed posture suggesting coiled readiness rather than relaxation
physical_description.hair_style: Short, close-cropped, maintained with functional precision
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with slight amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with reddish undertones — melanin-rich complexion from Sub-Saharan African and Pacific Islander ancestry, with subtle golden warmth from South Asian genetics creating a nuanced depth rather than uniform darkness
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with broad cheekbones and prominent jawline reflecting African and Pacific Islander ancestry; skin condition is clear but marked by the strain of augmentation surgery scars visible along temples and neck; grooming is meticulous but utilitarian — no cosmetics, no affectation
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 4cm along right temple, faint but visible under certain light, from wired reflexes installation

Chrome smartgun link interface visible on right forearm — gunmetal gray neural port inset at wrist, with thin silver filament traces running up inner forearm beneath translucent synthetic skin overlay
Burn scar on left shoulder blade, roughly 3cm diameter, pale and old — evidence of past operational mishap
Fine lattice of subdermal circuitry visible at base of neck when head is tilted back — faint blue-green bioluminescence when adrenaline pump is active
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right forearm smartgun link with exposed neural interface port at wrist — functional, unadorned chrome. Subdermal circuitry tracery at neck base glows faintly under stress or augmentation activation. No cosmetic chrome; all augmentations are work-driven and visible by necessity rather than aesthetic choice.
physical_description.posture_movement: Carries himself with compressed tension — shoulders slightly forward, spine straight but not rigid. Movements are economical and precise; he doesn't waste motion. When stationary, weight shifts constantly between balls of feet as if ready to move in any direction. Eyes track stimulus obsessively — reflex testing or paranoia, unclear which.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian runner kit — form-fitting tactical synth-weave bodysuit in charcoal gray with reinforced panels at shoulders and ribs; right forearm left bare to accommodate smartgun interface. Heavy-duty smartfabric jacket with asymmetrical fastening, pockets stuffed with maintenance tools and contract data chips. Worn Geartown-district boots with grip-sole modifications. No corporate branding, no flash — everything is functional and designed for rapid movement or environmental adaptation. Clothing shows signs of regular field use: scuff marks, repaired seams, faint chemical stains suggesting explosive residue or solvents.
